name: Fansubs.ru (Russian)
description: Russian fansub subtitles from fansubs.ru (Kage Project). Requires the unpacker resolver to be running - see README.md.

resolverBase.description: Base URL of the fansubs.ru unpacker resolver. Set to 'direct' to return raw fansubs.ru archive URLs instead.

preferredFormat.description: Preferred subtitle format. 'any' returns every matching release.

searchRetries.description: Retries for the search endpoint, which intermittently drops results.

useArchiveFallback.description: Browse the A-Z archive index when search returns nothing. Slower but far more reliable.

verifyAniDbId.description: Verify candidates against the AniDB id linked on the anime page when the query provides one.
